_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 2: item objects ($84CB-$86BB). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): first frame?
regions.description: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): type bit 7 set goes to the per-frame code (`$8543`). Table stats: `$31` and `$32` flags `$6A`, hit points 4, attack 1, death types `$B1` / `$B2`; `$33` flags `$6A`, no hit points; `$35` is the screen object (bank 5).

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): set-up
regions.description: `$0668` (the OPENED flag) := 0 and `$07B8` (the mode) := 0; metasprite `$0548` := `$31`.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): a box?
regions.description: Type `$31`?

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): the mode
regions.description: Mode 1 for a box in a labyrinth room; mode 2 when `$30` bit 5 or 6 is set (a special screen or a corridor: a gate's reward). Shop items stay mode 0.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): the item
regions.description: `$0680,X` := `$55`, the item id of the room (`$A377[sub-id]`, or `$EF40[corridor]` for a gate). A shop item has its id from the shop table instead.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): a shop item?
regions.description: Type `$33`?

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): shop item: its price on the floor
regions.description: `$07A0` (the sold flag) := 0; `JSR $C0AE`; the price `$0770 : $0758` is printed by `JSR $C04E` (`$E24B`) at the PPU address of the object's tile (`$05D8 : $05C0` + `$3F`): the number appears under the item. Then straight to the opened state (`$855E`). RUN: shop 1's items showed 1000 under each.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): box: wait for the other box
regions.description: `$56` is the id of the box that is open. Another box open (not `$FF`, not this id): an id of `$14` or more (a drop) does not wait, a real item does - the object returns until the other is taken. So only one item box is open at a time.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): box: mode 2 opens at once
regions.description: A gate's reward (mode 2) becomes type `$B1` and goes straight to the open state. RUN: the box in the cleared gate was open on its first frame.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): box: the stats
regions.description: `JSR $C0AE`: hit points 4.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): every frame: the scroll
regions.description: `JSR $C12C`: in a corridor the object slides with the scroll; carry (off the bottom) removes it.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): already open?
regions.description: `$0668` non-zero goes to the collecting code `$85DE`.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): closed: shoot it open
regions.description: Hit points 0 open it. Otherwise `JSR $C0CF` (`$D29F`, hit test, mask `$20`) and `JMP $C0D2` (`$D2BB`): the shots take its 4 hit points down; at 0 the death type `$B1` (the same type again) arrives with 0 hit points. RUN: touching the closed box did nothing.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): OPEN
regions.description: `$0668` := 1, metasprite `$25`; `JSR $880C`: an item id of `$14` or more is a drop (carry set), under that a real item (`$858E`).

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): a drop is shown as a tile
regions.description: A drop (item 20, 21, 22 from an enemy's box) draws its picture as background tiles `$858B[id - 20]` (`2C 24 28`) at the object's cell through `$8812` (the block-break routine with that tile, class 0).

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): position helper
regions.description: `$19 : $18 : $17` := x, y, 0 (the arguments of `$FA96`). RTS.

regions.name: Drop pictures: indexed by the item id - 20
regions.description: `0C 0B 01 | 2C 24 28`: read at `$8577 + id`; only ids 20-22 (`$858B-$858D` = `2C 24 28`) occur; the first three bytes are never read.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): a real item: shop item or box?
regions.description: Type `$B3`: a shop item.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): shop item: where the icon goes
regions.description: `$19 : $18` := `$100 + 16 x $0698`: the PPU address of the tile number the shop gave the item (`$5C`, `$D8`, `$DC`). (`$0698` is the item's icon tile.)

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): box: where the icon goes
regions.description: `$19 : $18` := `$15C0` (tile `$5C`) and `$56` := the item id: this box is now the open one.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): upload the icon
regions.description: `JSR $81B2` (slot `$8003` in this bank): icon A of the 18 at `$8E0C` is written to the CHR address. RUN: the opened box's picture appeared in tiles `$5C-$5F`.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): mode 2: no cell picture
regions.description: Mode 2 (a gate's reward) skips the picture and goes to collecting.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): show the item in its cell
regions.description: The cell gets the icon's tiles (`$0698` for a shop item, `$5C` for a box) through `$8812` and `$FA96` (class 0, so the ship can walk onto it).

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): collecting: a shop item?
regions.description: Only type `$B3` buys; others go to `$861C`.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): shop item: sold out
regions.description: `$07A0` non-zero (set by the shop's screen object when another item was bought): the cell turns to floor (tile `$1C`) and the item is removed. RUN: with one item bought the other two became floor within 14 frames.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): shop item: touched?
regions.description: `JSR $C0C3`: carry set when the ship touches it.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): shop item: can the player pay?
regions.description: The chips `$4D : $4C` minus the price `$0770 : $0758`; borrow returns (not enough).

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): return
regions.description: RTS.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): shop item: pay
regions.description: The chips become the difference; `$FCE7` with A = 0 redraws the counter and re-derives the gun tier; then collect. RUN: chips 4095 -> 3095 for a price of 1000.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): box: touched?
regions.description: `JSR $C0C3`; carry clear returns.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): collect
regions.description: An id under `$14` clears `$56` ($FF): the box is no longer the open one.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): collect: the cell becomes floor
regions.description: Unless mode 2: tile `$1C`, class 0 (`$FA96`-family `$C11A`).

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): collect: which mode
regions.description: Mode 0 (a shop item) applies the item; mode 1 sets the item flag; mode 2 does the gate.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): mode 2: the gate's reward
regions.description: Sparks at x `$50` and `$90` (bank 1 `$8003` through `$8817`), then a far call (inline `01 05 80`) to bank 1 `$8006` with A = `$10`, Y = `$FF`, `$19` = `$70`, `$18` = `$60`. RUN: sparks at x 80 and 144, and breaks at the door cells.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): mode 2: on to the doors
ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): mode 1: remember it
regions.description: `JSR $C066` (`$EFE9`): the item flag `$5E` (the room's sub-id) is set, so the box does not come back. RUN: the flag array gained the room's bit.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): the door cells: scan
regions.description: Eight records of 4 bytes at `$87EC` ([cell][new class][attribute][opening mask]): the class under the cell must be 14.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): the door cells: change
regions.description: If the room's opening bit (`$54 AND mask`) is set, the cell gets the picture `$14` with the record's class and attribute through `$8812`. **In a cleared gate the 'open door' cell (metatile `$0C`, class 14) becomes class 10, the cover that takes four shots, and the outer cell class 8** - so the reward opens the way to the warp panel. RUN: in corridor 5's gate the cell (7, 2) went from class 14 to 10 when the reward was taken. Class 14 occurs nowhere else in the map's rooms (checked for every ordinary room).

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): the door cells: next
regions.description: X += 4 until `$20`.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): apply the item
regions.description: `LDA $0680,X / JSR $86BC`: the effect of the item (see the pick-up effects). RUN: item 20 gave +40 life; the shop's item 20 +40.

regions.name: ITEM OBJECTS (bank 2 slot `$800F`, reached from bank 6 `$99F1` for types `$31` box, `$32` and `$33` shop item; X = the object): remove the object
regions.description: `PLA / TAX / JMP $C048`.

regions.name: Gate door cells: 8 x [cell][class][attribute][opening mask]
regions.description: `27 08 55 80 | 37 0A 00 80 | 71 08 55 40 | 72 0A 00 40 | 7E 08 55 20 | 7D 0A 00 20 | B7 08 55 10 | A7 0A 00 10`: for each exit N, W, E, S an outer cell (row x 16 + column: (2,7), (7,1), (7,14), (11,7)) that becomes class 8 and an inner cell ((3,7), (7,2), (7,13), (10,7), the door cells `$EEB7` opens) that becomes class 10; the mask is the opening bit of `$54`.
